upstream.api_basis: Ownership, bounded Result API; no STM32 register protocol imported
upstream.alarm_api_qualification: Pinned embassy-stm32 rtc/mod.rs, v2.rs and v3.rs have no public alarm configuration/wait API. This CW32 extension retains the rtc module, DateTime names, Peri ownership and typed interrupt binding organization; no nonexistent STM32 alarm API is claimed.

scope.all_calendars: Typed Alarm A match/enable and Alarm A/B status/selective acknowledgement
scope.direct_access_only: Scoped run-mode async wait using the dedicated RTC vector; preserve flags on success/cancellation
excluded: Alarm B match programming/enabling: conflicting mask polarity

render_reproduction.comparison: Concatenate behavior, ALARMA and ALARMB PNGs left-to-right at original dimensions on white background using Pillow; source pages and hashes are recorded per family.
render_reproduction.redistribution: Rendered vendor pages remain external local evidence, excluded from project-authored source and review ZIP. Obtain the official PDF from its cited URL to reproduce.
